description: Where your launch stands, as the site's page follows it: { status, mint } with status pending (ask again in a few seconds), split (a pump.fun launch landed: transaction is the second approval, the split of its creator fee, for your wallet to sign; then submit_split), confirmed (the coin is on Souvenir) or failed (with reason). Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." (403 not_open) only if Souvenir pauses launching through the API. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

signature.description: The signature submit_launch answered; without it, the one Souvenir recorded.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
